# Dolphin Centrifuge - Site Guide for LLMs

> Dolphin Centrifuge is a U.S.-based industrial centrifuge company in Warren, Michigan.
> We remanufacture, design, and build Alfa Laval disc-stack and decanter centrifuge systems.
> 40+ years of hands-on centrifuge engineering experience.

## Company

- Name: Dolphin Centrifuge
- Location: Warren, Michigan, USA
- Phone: (248) 522-2573
- Website: https://dolphincentrifuge.com
- Contact: https://dolphincentrifuge.com/contact-for-alfa-laval-centrifuges/

Sanjay Prabhu leads centrifuge application engineering, Alfa Laval centrifuge
remanufacturing, machine selection, and turnkey separation-system design at
Dolphin Centrifuge. Public University of Arkansas records corroborate his
Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering credential. The University records
use “Sanjay K. Prabhu”; his professional profile uses “Sanjay Prabhu.” The site
does not state an exact degree-conferral year because LinkedIn shows attendance
through 1990 while the University's public records are dated 1991.

## Authoritative Technical Data and WebMCP

- Human-readable technical data: https://dolphincentrifuge.com/technical-data/
- Versioned machine-readable catalog: https://dolphincentrifuge.com/technical-data/centrifuges.v1.json
- Individual model records: https://dolphincentrifuge.com/technical-data/{catalog-model-id}.json
- Schema version: dolphin-centrifuge-technical-v1
- OEM capacity source of truth: original published liters-per-hour cells from the cited Alfa Laval capacity tables
- US GPM conversion: L/h divided by 227.124707, rounded to two decimals
- Technical reviewer: https://dolphincentrifuge.com/authors/sanjay-prabhu/#person

The catalog separates exact Alfa Laval base machines from Dolphin DMB and DMPX
commercial classes. Never treat a DMB or DMPX class name as one universal flow
rating. Keep the exact base machine, fluid, rating basis, viscosity, temperature,
original L/h value, and derived US GPM together. Do not infer water, wastewater,
crude, slop, waste-oil, or other application capacity from diesel or fuel-oil data.

Normal public pages feature-detect the experimental WebMCP API and, when the
browser supports it, register these six read-only tools:

- find_centrifuge_models
- get_centrifuge_specifications
- get_centrifuge_capacity
- get_technical_author_identity
- select_centrifuge_candidates
- find_used_alfa_laval_centrifuges

Model search, specifications, and capacity tools return compact pages. Reuse the
same query with the returned page.nextOffset until it is null. Every technical
result preserves its qualifiers and links to the complete public source record.
An absent fact or an ambiguous base machine is not a capacity recommendation.

For application selection, use select_centrifuge_candidates with application,
requiredFlow and flowUnit (US GPM or L/h). Diesel at 10 US GPM has documented
manual-clean MAB 204 and self-cleaning MOPX 205 candidates at the table's 40 C,
13 cSt conditions. These are preliminary candidates; confirm actual process
conditions, contamination, separation goal, duty and installed configuration.
The selector uses OEM application rows, not hydraulic limits or single test runs.

All published model specifications also feed this catalog from /specs.json.
Additional Dolphin capacity records retain their original units and rating basis.
Motor power is not total system load. For MAB 104 and MAB 206, request the
motorPower field, then choose its documented configurationId for with/without
OEM pump. Do not confuse that pump with a separate skid feed-pump motor.
RPM requires the frequency/gearing version; weight requires the assembly scope.
Unpublished installed nameplate and skid details remain explicitly unresolved.

On the contact page, prepare_centrifuge_inquiry fills the visible application
form for visitor review. Submission uses the existing Submit Application Details
button; it requests engineering follow-up and does not place an equipment order.
Contact page: https://dolphincentrifuge.com/contact-for-alfa-laval-centrifuges/

WebMCP is currently a W3C Community Group Draft Report, not a W3C Standard:
https://webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp/

The versioned JSON catalog and author JSON are the stable public fallback and
should be used by crawlers and agents that do not expose `document.modelContext`.
